Mode-Specific Changes

[edit | edit source]

Global stat changes

[edit | edit source]
  • Every 1% critical strike chance in excess of 100% grants 0.45 bonus Attack Damage or 0.75 Ability Power (Adaptive).
  • Attack speed cap changed to 5.0.
  • All champions gain the following stats:
    • ( 20 – 600 / 20 – 400) (based on level)  base health
    • 10% bonus  mana regeneration or  energy regeneration
    • ( 15 / 2 – 25 (based on level))  bonus armor and  bonus magic resistance
      • Note: Currently no bonus armor and bonus magic resistance is granted to ranged champions(bug).

Combo Breaker

[edit | edit source]

Being affected by immobilizing crowd control grants X% tenacity with each instance of a disable that is applied outside of a series of concurrent immobilizations, lasting for 3.25 seconds and refreshing on subsequent triggers. Additionally, if a champion has been immobilized for 5 out of the last 7 seconds, they will be cleansed of all crowd control and become immune to them for 3 seconds.

Miscellaneous changes

[edit | edit source]
  • All champions gain Presence of Mind.
  • Minion waves spawn only 1 super minion while the opposing team's inhibitor is destroyed.
  • Siege minions have an aura that grants 20% bonus attack speed and 20% bonus movement speed to nearby allied minions.
  • Nexus turret health increased to 3000 from 1800.
  • Nexus health reduced to 3000 from 5500.
  • Inhibitor turret damage reduction after the Outer turret is destroyed has been changed to 40% and lasts 70 seconds.
  • Health relic:
    • Area of effect heal increased to 22% missing health from 16%.
    • Area of effect mana restore increased to 22% missing mana from 16%.

List of mode overrides

[edit | edit source]
See ARAM#Mode-Specific_Changes for all details.

ARAM: Mayhem features all overrides from regular ARAM plus an additional layer of overrides for specific champions, items, and runes. Champion damage dealt modifiers apply to damage dealt by basic attacks, abilities, spells, items, and augments, while damage received modifiers only apply to basic attacks, abilities, and spells.
